question: Bianca had 45 coloring books. If she gave away 6 of them, but then bought 20 more, how many would she have total?
In fourth grade there were 35 students at the start of the year. During the year 10 students left and 10 new students came to school. How many students were in fourth grade at the end?
Robin had 30 songs on her mp3 player. If she deleted 8 old songs from it and then added 10 new songs, how many songs does she have on her mp3 player?
The school cafeteria had 17 apples. If they used 2 to make lunch for the students and then bought 23 more, how many apples would they have?
John had 33 socks. If he threw away 19 old ones that didn't fit and bought 13 new ones, how many socks would he have?
Luke had 48 dollars in January. By March he had spent 11 dollars. If he got another 21 dollars from his mom, how much money would he have?
A florist had 50 roses. If she sold 15 of them and then later picked 21 more, how many roses would she have?
A store had 40 oranges in a bin. If they threw away 25 of the old ones and put 21 new ones in the bin, how many would be in the bin?
For a birthday party Cody bought thirty regular sodas and five diet sodas. If his fridge would only hold seven on each shelf, how many shelves would he fill up?
Paul made forty-four dollars mowing lawns and twenty-eight dollars weed eating. If he only spent nine dollar a week, how long would the money last him?
The school's baseball team had two new players and twenty-two returning players. If the coach put them into groups with three players in each group, how many groups would there be?

Chloe and her friends were recycling paper for their class. For every six pounds they recycled they earned 1 point. If Chloe recycled twenty-eight pounds and her friends recycled two pounds, how many points did they earn?

A group of nine friends went into a restaurant. The chef already had two chicken wings cooked but cooked twenty-five more for the group. If they each got the same amount, how many would each person get?
For homework Megan had thirty-six math problems and twenty-eight spelling problems. If she can finish eight problems in an hour, how long will it take her to finish all the problems?
Gwen's class is going on a field trip to the zoo. If each van can hold seven people and there are thirty-three students and nine adults going, how many vans will they need?
Wendy was playing a video game where she scores five points for each treasure she finds. If she found four treasures on the first level and three on the second, what would her score be?
Paul bought six boxes of chocolate candy and four boxes of caramel candy. If each box has nine pieces inside it, how much candy did he have total?
At Billy's Restaurant a group with two adults and five children came in to eat. If each meal cost three dollars, how much was the bill?

Haley's favorite band was holding a concert where tickets were four dollars each. Haley bought three tickets for herself and her friends and five extra tickets in case anyone else wanted to go. How much did she spend?
Victor and his friend were buying trick decks from the magic shop for eight dollars each. How much did they spend if Victor bought six decks and his friend bought two decks?
Katie was selling her necklaces at a garage sale. She sold four bead necklaces and three gem stone necklaces. If each necklace cost three dollars, how much money did she earn?
Tiffany had six pages of math homework and four pages of reading homework. If each page had three problems on it, how many problems did she have to complete total?
Zoe was unboxing some of her old winter clothes. She found eight boxes of clothing and inside each box there were four scarves and six mittens. How many pieces of winter clothing did Zoe have total?

Gwen was organizing her book case making sure each of the shelves had exactly four books on it. If she had five shelves of mystery books and three shelves of picture books, how many books did she have total?
Rachel bought seven new chairs and three new tables for her house. If she spent four minutes on each piece furniture putting it together, how many minutes did it take her to finish?
